limitations: One synthetic resident and one continuous quiet world, with matching player inputs but naturally different generated histories.
This records all 61 reported requests across implementation iterations. It is not a randomized before/after experiment.
Rates change from peak to off-peak at 10:00 UTC; same-rate mode comparisons and token counts must be used for improvement claims.
Costs are usage multiplied by published rates, not invoice amounts. Cache writes and provider-internal retries are unreported.
Reasoning tokens are a subset of output and are charged once. Saved model and reasoning parameters were preserved.
The same complete stored Mara card is used in both modes. The native Game Mode prompt representation differs from Villages; scenario/example text did not appear verbatim in the inspected Game prompt.

Changed-prefix and cold-start costs remain in the dataset. One conclusive contract rejection required an explicit replacement; two later Memory-source failures preserved prose and were continued without those unsupported updates. Their purchases remain billed failures.
Transport completion does not establish semantic success. One later explicit learning request was acknowledged without a persisted Memory; immediate Scene recall is recorded separately.
